auditor.independence: Auditor session b973c86b28e4 (task role, lopdev lane move-working-set, manager 35c4f00e8d73). Translator was a different session: agent coder, job eacba7a3806e, session 76c99189cb1d. Same served model family as the translator (anthropic/claude-opus-5-5), different agent and run; no fallback. No MT or translation API used.

findings.problem: Typography: 15 keys put a plain U+0020 before ':' and 19 keys use the ASCII apostrophe U+0027. fr.md Punctuation & typography requires U+202F before : ; ! ? and the apostrophe U+2019; the rest of the fr corpus has 1086 U+202F-before-punctuation vs 35 U+0020, and 2730 values with U+2019 vs 15 with U+0027 (measured). A plain space also lets the colon wrap onto a new line in this wrapping dialog.
findings.fix: Replace U+0020 before ':' with U+202F (e.g. 'vers {device} : les worktrees…', 'indexés : {staged…}') and every ' with ’ (n’a, d’un, l’autre, L’historique…). Not inside {…} or ::group-off skeletons.

findings.problem: push/commit are translated ('non poussés', 'Poussez', 'non validées', 'validez') although fr.md's kept-English list keeps commit/push English ('translating them ("validation") reads foreign'), and the shipped corpus says 'avez fait un push' / 'Push automatique'. Meaning survives (these are git-fr's own l10n verbs and do not collide with this dialog's 'confirmez'), so MINOR.
findings.fix: 'commits non pushés' (or 'commits sans push'), 'modifications non commitées'; remedies 'Faites un push ou un commit de ce dont vous avez besoin…', 'Faites un push du commit ou réécrivez-le…', 'Faites-en un push, ou clonez-le…', 'Faites un push des commits…'.

findings.problem: 'Je suis certain que…' is masculine-only in a first-person consent checkbox every user must tick; the English is gender-neutral and the fr corpus's consent labels are neutral ('Je comprends que…', 'Je confirme avoir lu…'; 0 corpus hits for 'Je suis certain').
findings.fix: 'Je confirme que {device} doit recevoir ces fichiers'

findings.problem: 'modifiés' for unstaged is imprecise (staged files are modified too); git-fr pairs 'indexés' with 'non indexés'.

findings.note: Mechanical checks on the committed bytes at dd014c1e9d (scratch script run with the repo's @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser): key set equals English; the base..head diff of this file is exactly the 42 added working_set_* lines (0 changed, 0 removed values, so every other value is the bytes audited by the superseded row); every audited value parses and carries the same arguments, types and ::group-off skeletons as English; plural arms present for every CLDR category of the locale and no foreign arm; NFC; no bidi controls (U+200E/F, U+202A-E, U+2066-9, U+061C); no ASCII '...'; no leading/trailing/double spaces; no <Trans> tags in this namespace. Rendered fit NOT verified in this lane (no rendered frames).
